worlds.name: JP's Solarpunk Meadow
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A sunlit promenade through wind-blown wildflowers and brass solar arches.

worlds.name: Breezy Plant Garden
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Giant flat-coloured tropical plants from JP's portfolio garden, swaying in the breeze and bending away as you pass.

worlds.name: Kāneʻohe Fishpond
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Hawaiian coastal loko iʻa — turquoise TSL lagoon, basalt kuapā walls, swaying palms, reef fish, and Koʻolau cliffs.

worlds.name: Coral Reef Walk
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A sandy path through a coral canyon on the sea floor: caustic light, jellyfish, fish schools, a turtle and a manta ray.

worlds.name: Apartment
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: An open-plan loft above the night city, with warm lamps, a kitchen island and a shiba who follows you around.

worlds.name: Relay
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A mirror-black floor in the dark, with ranks of square rack cages standing off it. Orange slashed-zero glyphs chase round the LED rims of their stacked platters, climbing each tower and growing tails, like cues on a lighting console.

worlds.name: Abyss
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A crooked path of ancient floating stones high above a chasm of drifting fog, glowing from beneath and trailing smoke, with needle spires rising out of the murk.

worlds.name: Visage — Neon
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Two endless rows of colossal ancient stone heads with obsidian-black eyes facing a rough matte stone path pooled with liquid crimson, marching past both portals into pitch darkness.

worlds.name: Visage (Claude variant)
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Two endless rows of colossal ancient stone heads, buried to the chin with polished black eyes, stare across a rough cobbled path pooled with blood, vanishing into the dark beyond both portals.

worlds.name: Visage — Codex
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Two endless ranks of colossal ancient stone faces watch a rubble-strewn path. Black glass eyes and crimson liquid shine in the cold darkness.

worlds.name: Visage
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A forgotten avenue of colossal weathered faces, black moon-mirroring eyes, broken monuments and dark crimson pools, stretching endlessly into the night.

worlds.name: Palace Lagoon
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Earth's Palace of Fine Arts across a mirror-still lagoon at golden hour, seen from a wind-blown wildflower meadow. The first room drawn with weft instead of Three.js.

worlds.name: Laser Forcefield Arena
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Pitch-black light-show gallery with sweeping TSL laser fans, pulsing forcefield walls, and floating refractive prisms.

worlds.name: Alpine Snow Run
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Twilight alpine snow promenade lined with lantern-lit sled fences, frosted fir forests, alpenglow peaks, and falling snow.

worlds.name: Bioluminescent Redwood Grove
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Nocturnal redwood cathedral under shimmering TSL aurora curtains, glowing mushrooms that react as you pass, and drifting firefly spores.

worlds.name: Golden Cloud Observatory
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Floating marble-and-brass celestial bridge above a sunset sea of TSL clouds, crowned by colossal rotating brass armillary rings.

worlds.name: Honey in da Hood Ya Heard
worlds.author: simplesessions
worlds.description: A twisty road through honey-dripping trees, golden plants, a fire hydrant, and a giant bee in a blue jacket who eats passing birds.

worlds.name: Sector 9 Rain Corner
worlds.author: Doug (douglascalhoun)
worlds.description: A dense Blade Runner Neo-Tokyo street corner under a dead-channel static sky behind low rain clouds: day/night & dynamic rain cycle, White Dragon open-air noodle bar, scheduled cyber shops, future-punks & animal-hybrid humans on foot and neon scooters dissolving into polygon wireframes at the street edge, a rare sparking Electro-Punk Trolley stopping for passengers, live NPC dialogue, and five hidden easter eggs.

worlds.name: Frostfire Hollow
worlds.author: simplesessions
worlds.description: A lava cave where a hilly path splits around a menacing horned lava monster who roars fire at you. Step on a switch to freeze the whole cavern to slippery ice, and back again.

worlds.name: Starlight Dance Pavilion
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Celestial Art-Deco festival pavilion where Soraya, Dex, and Ermelin dance together in 88 BPM harmony — select any of them to take over dancing with phone swipes, mouse/trackpad, or keyboard, cast 6 elemental spells, ride Zero-G Star Geysers, and light the Harmonic Chime Totems for Starlight Overdrive.
